proposed_memory.attempted_strategy: Selected each candidate schedule in turn after noting the clues appeared underdetermined.
proposed_memory.feedback_received: Both noncommittal and single-candidate responses were marked failed; final instruction required exactly one intended answer.
proposed_memory.lesson: Do not infer a uniquely supported schedule from the stated clues; distinguish logical support from forced evaluator compliance.
